subject: design/feature-implementation-drive-local-git
statement: Once every planned and repair task is RecordLanding-complete, the `CandidateBuilder` fetches exact feature head `F` and exact target-main head `M`, verifies both refs resolve to those objects, and computes one canonical synthetic merge `C` (`design-brainstorm:feature-implementation-drive-tech-design#D-4`). It uses the repository's declared merge policy and a version-pinned builder algorithm to produce a merge tree, then a two-parent commit `(M, F)` with canonical author/committer identity, message, and deterministic timestamp rule. The candidate identity records builder version, merge-policy version, `F`, `M`, `C`, and tree id.
